credentials.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
credentials.label: Claude Code — API billing
credentials.fix: Paste a Console API key. Billed per token, not against a subscription.
credentials.note: Outranks CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in Claude Code's credential precedence.

credentials.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
credentials.label: Claude Code — Pro/Max subscription
credentials.fix: Run `claude setup-token` on a machine with a browser, then paste the token here.
credentials.note: This wizard cannot mint it: minting is a browser flow with no headless variant.

credentials.name: XAI_API_KEY
credentials.label: grok — API billing
credentials.fix: Paste an xAI API key, or run `grok login --device-auth` over SSH for a subscription.

credentials.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
credentials.label: Gemini
credentials.fix: Paste a Google AI Studio key.
credentials.note: UNVERIFIED that the Gemini CLI reads this name — see the report.

credentials.name: GH_TOKEN
credentials.label: GitHub CLI
credentials.fix: Paste a PAT, or run `gh auth login --with-token` over SSH.
